That hash covers score-determining fields whose implementation would be invented here rather than reproduced. A reconstruction could be made to run and produce numbers, but those numbers would belong to a different system, and reporting them as SYSTEM-H's would be exactly the kind of unfalsifiable claim this program has refused everywhere else.
